places.name: Indian Territory
places.note: The herd crosses days of empty grassland, seeing no one; the men fret about Indians and wonder where the next people are.
places.location_hint: between the Red River and the Canadian River

places.raw_name: out in the middle of the plain
places.name: Bill Spettle's grave
places.note: Lightning drops thirteen cattle and kills Bill Spettle, stampeding the herd west; he is hastily buried on the muddy plain.
places.location_hint: open plain in Indian Territory about half a day's drive south of the Canadian River crossing; the main herd ended up about four miles from the river

places.name: Canadian River
places.note: The naked crew swims the herd across at a well-used crossing during a fierce hailstorm; afterward Pea Eye spots Gus riding toward them.
places.location_hint: at a much-used trail-herd crossing, in Indian Territory

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Needle expects to reach it; Dish says it would be easy to miss if no bigger than Dodge.

places.name: Dodge City
places.note: Dish uses it as a measure of how small a town can be.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: on the north bank of the Canadian just after the hailstorm crossing

groups.label: Augustus
groups.hint: seen riding toward the outfit from across the river
